about_the_game:
Story

This is a fantasy world filled with the romantic elements of sword and magic, monster and adventurer.

—'New Yade',

the first and so far only city established on the New Continent, young and full of vitality, rich in natural resources and brimming with opportunities.

New Yade draws people from all over the world across the ocean to settle in this promising land.

The protagonist, Nora, is an ordinary girl. At the invitation of Mr. Bark, an old friend of her mother’s, she comes to New Yade to help him run the newly opened Red Fox Tavern.

Charming and colorful guests frequently visit the Red Fox Tavern. As the tavern’s only maid, Nora’s job is to greet them, take orders, serve food—and be a good conversationalist when the mood strikes.

She spends her peaceful days working, while listening to the most interesting stories her guests have to share.

Through these conversations, she slowly begins to understand the everyday lives of the people in 'New Yade' and the wonders of the fantastical world around her.

What You’ll Experience

– An immersive and enchanting fantasy world

– A unique visual novel-style narrative

– A relaxing and laid-back gameplay atmosphere

– Rich and engaging storylines

– Over 20 charming characters, each with distinct personalities and designs

– A collection of original, beautifully composed music tracks

content_descriptors.notes: 'Tavern Maid’s Daily Life' is a role-playing game set in a fantasy world.The game contains female characters with revealing outfits.There are also depictions of alcohol consumption.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Core i5-10300H
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Core i5-10600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: In 'Tavern Maid’s Daily Life' you play as a maid working at the 'Red Fox Tavern', serving all kinds of customers and enjoying a cozy, eventful everyday life. Between casual chats and daily chores, you’ll gradually uncover the deeper stories and mysteries of the fantasy world around you.
